IsSpreadsheetFile.name: IsSpreadsheetFile
IsSpreadsheetFile.description: Determines whether a file is a spreadsheet file.

arguments.name: filepath
arguments.description: The path to the file to check. * *

IsSpreadsheetFile.returns: True if the file is a valid spreadsheet file, false otherwise.

IsSpreadsheetObject.name: IsSpreadsheetObject
IsSpreadsheetObject.description: Determines whether an object is a BoxLang spreadsheet object.
IsSpreadsheetObject.returns: True if the object is a SpreadsheetFile instance, false otherwise.

Spreadsheet.name: Spreadsheet

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The path to the spreadsheet file to load or the path where the spreadsheet file will be stored at * *

arguments.name: sheetname
arguments.description: The name of the sheet to work with (optional). Default is "Sheet1". * *

arguments.name: xmlformat
arguments.description: Whether the spreadsheet should use XML format (.xlsx). Default is true. * *

Spreadsheet.returns: A fluent SpreadsheetFile object that can be used to read or write properties.

SpreadsheetAddAutofilter.name: SpreadsheetAddAutofilter
SpreadsheetAddAutofilter.description: Adds auto filters to a spreadsheet.

arguments.name: row
arguments.description: The starting row for the autofilter (1-based). Default is 1. * *

arguments.name: startColumn
arguments.description: The starting column for the autofilter (1-based). Default is 1. * *

arguments.name: endRow
arguments.description: The ending row for the autofilter (1-based). If not specified, uses all rows with data. * *

arguments.name: endColumn
arguments.description: The ending column for the autofilter (1-based). If not specified, uses all columns with data. * *

SpreadsheetAddColumn.name: SpreadsheetAddColumn
SpreadsheetAddColumn.description: Adds columns to a spreadsheet object.

arguments.name: data
arguments.description: An array of data to add to the column. * *

arguments.name: column

arguments.name: insert
arguments.description: Whether to insert a new column or overwrite existing column. Default is false. * *

arguments.name: datatype
arguments.description: The data type to apply to the cells (not implemented in this version). * *

SpreadsheetAddFreezePane.description: Adds freeze pane to a spreadsheet.

arguments.name: row

arguments.name: endColumn
arguments.description: An additional column to be included in the freeze pane (optional). * *

arguments.name: endRow
arguments.description: An additional row to be included in the freeze pane (optional). * *

SpreadsheetAddImage.name: SpreadsheetAddImage
SpreadsheetAddImage.description: Adds an image to a spreadsheet.

arguments.name: row

arguments.name: anchor

SpreadsheetAddPrintGridlines.name: SpreadsheetAddPrintGridlines
SpreadsheetAddPrintGridlines.description: Adds print gridlines to the active sheet or specified sheet.

arguments.name: sheetName

SpreadsheetAddRow.name: SpreadsheetAddRow
SpreadsheetAddRow.description: Adds a row to an Excel spreadsheet object.

arguments.name: data
arguments.description: An array of data to add to the row, or a comma delimited string of cell entries, one per column * *

arguments.name: row
arguments.description: The row number where to insert the data (1-based). If not specified, adds to the end. * *

arguments.name: column
arguments.description: The column number where to start inserting the data (1-based). Default is 1. * *

arguments.name: insert
arguments.description: Whether to insert a new row or overwrite existing row. Default is false. * *

SpreadsheetAddRows.name: SpreadsheetAddRows
SpreadsheetAddRows.description: Adds multiple rows from a query to an Excel spreadsheet object.

arguments.name: data
arguments.description: The data to add - can be an array of arrays or an array of structs. * *

arguments.name: row
arguments.description: The row number where to start inserting the data (1-based). If not specified, adds to the end. * *

arguments.name: column
arguments.description: The column number where to start inserting the data (1-based). Default is 1. * *

arguments.name: insert
arguments.description: Whether to insert new rows or overwrite existing rows. Default is false. * *

arguments.name: datatype
arguments.description: The data type to apply to the cells (not implemented in this version). * *

arguments.name: includeColumnNames
arguments.description: Whether to include column names as the first row. Default is false. * *

SpreadsheetAddRows.method_signature: SpreadsheetAddRows(spreadsheetObj=[any], data=[any], row=[any], column=[any], insert=[any], datatype=[any], includeColumnNames=[any])

SpreadsheetFormatCell.name: SpreadsheetFormatCell
SpreadsheetFormatCell.description: Formats the contents of a single cell of an Excel spreadsheet object.

SpreadsheetFormatCellRange.name: SpreadsheetFormatCellRange
SpreadsheetFormatCellRange.description: Formats a range of cells in a spreadsheet with a single format struct.

SpreadsheetFormatColumn.name: SpreadsheetFormatColumn

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: A structure containing formatting options (bold, italic, color, etc.). * *

SpreadsheetFormatColumns.description: Formats multiple columns of an Excel spreadsheet object.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: A structure containing formatting options (bold, italic, color, etc.). * *

arguments.name: columns
arguments.description: The columns to format, in one of the following formats: * - startColumn-endColumn for a range (e.g., "1-5") * - column,column,column for individual columns (e.g., "1,3,5") * - combinations like "1-3,5,7-10" * *

SpreadsheetFormatRow.name: SpreadsheetFormatRow
SpreadsheetFormatRow.description: Formats a row of an Excel spreadsheet object.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: A structure containing formatting options (bold, italic, color, etc.). * *

SpreadsheetFormatRows.name: SpreadsheetFormatRows
SpreadsheetFormatRows.description: Formats multiple rows of an Excel spreadsheet object.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: A structure containing formatting options (bold, italic, color, etc.). * *

arguments.name: rows
arguments.description: The rows to format, in one of the following formats: * - startRow-endRow (e.g., "1-5") - Formats rows in a single range * - row,row,row... (e.g., "1,3,5") - Formats individual rows * - Combinations allowed (e.g., "1-5,6,7,9-12") * *

SpreadsheetRead.name: SpreadsheetRead
